---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new idea or feature for the range
title: "[FEATURE] <title>"
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A brief description of the idea/feature.

## Motivation

Why is this feature important? Who uses it (red team, blue team, white cell, a range operator, a developer), and what can they do with it that they cannot do now?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision the feature. Include any relevant details, such as:

- The plant model, simulation, or PLC programs it changes
- The hosts, networks, or conduits it adds or changes
- The images it needs, and what they cost in vCPUs and memory
- Any other relevant information

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or approaches? If so, please describe them.

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here, including related issues, pull requests, or sections of `docs/DESIGN.md` and `docs/FUTURE_WORK.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have included no proprietary/sensitive information in my issue.
- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and believe this is not a duplicate of an existing feature request
